title: HAP
description: HAP is a simple client-side mod that adds health hearts above other players' heads. The hearts pulse in real time and reflect their current HP—convenient for PvP and co-op.
body:
HAP — Hearts Above Players
Always know who's barely alive next to you. This mod displays health hearts right above each player's head—live, pulsating, and honest. No more guessing whether to charge in or retreat.
